Contracts for Oct. 8, 2026

MISSILE DEFENSE AGENCY

Raytheon, Tucson, Arizona, is being awarded a noncompetitive, multi-year undefinitized contract action on a new contract (HQ0851-27-C-E001). The base value of this contract is $4,432,040,944 with a total value, including options, of $6,342,404,516. Under this contract, the contractor will manufacture and assemble Standard Missile-3 Block IB All-Up-Rounds for the government. The work will be performed in Tucson, Arizona; and Huntsville, Alabama, with an estimated completion date of Oct. 31, 2034. Fiscal 2026 procurement funds in the amount of $454,215,132 are being obligated on this award. The Missile Defense Agency, Huntsville, Alabama, is the contracting activity. (Awarded on Oct. 7, 2026).

DEFENSE FINANCE ACCOUNTING SERVICE

Ernst & Young LLP, New York, New York, is being awarded a labor-hour contract with a maximum value of $455,430,043. This contract is for financial statement audit services for the Department of War Office of Inspector General, Audits of the Navy General Fund, the Marine Corps General Fund, and Department of Navy Working Capital Fund fiscal 2027-2031. Work will be performed in Tysons, Virginia, and other locations within and outside of the continental U.S., with an expected completion date of Dec. 31, 2031. The contract includes a one-year base period and four, individual one-year option periods. This contract is the result of a competitive acquisition for which the government received one quote. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $96,527,833 will be obligated, when available, prior to the start of performance. The Defense Finance and Accounting Service, Contract Services Directorate, Columbus, Ohio, is the contracting activity (HQ042327FE001).

Ernst & Young LLP, New York, New York, is being awarded a labor-hour contract with a maximum value of $413,954,469 for audit services of the Department of the Air Force general fund and working capital fund financial statements. Work will be performed in McLean, Virginia, with an expected completion date of Dec. 31, 2027. This contract is the result of a competitive acquisition for which one quote was received. The contract has a 12-month base period plus four individual one-year option periods. Subject to availability of funding, fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance Air Force funds in the amount of $58,781,171 will be obligated when funds are available for this contract. The Defense Finance and Accounting Service, Contract Services Directorate, Columbus, Ohio, is the contracting activity (HQ0423-27-F-E004).

DEFENSE ADVANCED RESEARCH PROJECTS AGENCY

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA), Alexandria, Virginia, has been awarded a $51,699,826, cost-plus-fixed-fee task order for operational and support services. This task order will specifically support technical, programmatic, financial, and administrative management of new and ongoing technology programs. The location of performance is Arlington, Virginia. The work is expected to be completed by October 2027. This award is the result of a competitive acquisition, and two offers were received. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation funds in the amount of $2,066,115 are being obligated at the time of award. The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, Arlington, Virginia, is the contracting activity (HR001127FE003).

DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY

Gentex Corp., Simpson, Pennsylvania, has been awarded an estimated $39,933,725 modification (P00056) exercising the fourth one-year option period of a one-year base contract (SPE1C1-23-D-0004) with four one-year option periods for advanced combat helmets. This is a firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract. The ordering period end date is Oct. 16, 2027. Using military service is Army. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2026 through 2027 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

Sylvan Forest Products Inc.,* Portland, Oregon (SPE8E6-27-D-0001); S&S Forest Products LLC,* Boerne, Texas (SPE8E6-27-D-0002) and Forest Products Distributors Inc.,* Rapid City, South Dakota (SPE8E6-27-D-0003) are sharing an estimated $15,788,784 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract under solicitation (SPE8E6-26-R-0003) for lumber, millwork and plywood to support the Wood Products Tailored Logistics Support Program West Region. This was a competitive acquisition with seven responses received. These are two-year base contracts with three one-year option periods. The ordering period end date is Oct. 7, 2028. Using customers are Army, Navy, Marine Corps, Air Force and Coast Guard. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2027 through 2029 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

UPDATE: Ethicon US LLC, Raritan, New Jersey (SPE2DH-27-D-0001, $48,000,000), has been added as an awardee to the multiple award contract for hospital supplies and equipment for the Defense Logistics Agency Electronic Catalog, issued against solicitation (SPE2DH-21-R-0002) and awarded Feb. 10, 2022. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

CORRECTION: The contract announced on Oct. 1, 2026, to Crowley Government Services Inc., Jacksonville, Florida (SPE605-26-D-8600), for $35,938,441 was announced with an incorrect contract number. The correct contract number is (SPE605-27-D-8600). The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Energy, Fort Belvoir, Virginia.

DEFENSE HEALTH AGENCY

Accenture Federal Services, LLC, Arlington, Virginia is awarded a $10,994,689 option modification (P00018) to previously awarded firm-fixed-price contract (HT003824C0004) for a total cumulative value of $45,975,743. Modification is a six-month option period in support of the Program Acquisition Executive – Medical Digital Solutions, Joint Operation Medicine Information Systems Program Management Office CustomerX Pod 2 initiative providing user adoption, training and exercise, and release and deployment support. This six-month option period begins Oct. 8, 2026, and concludes on April 7, 2027. Work location is within the contiguous United States, which could include Fort Campbell, Kentucky; the USS Kearsarge, Norfolk, Virginia; Fort Hood, Texas; Fort McCoy, Wisconsin; San Antonio, Texas; TravisAir Force Base, Dallas, Texas; Camp Beauregard, Louisiana; Tampa, Florida; and others to be determined; and outside the contiguous United States, which could include Pacific Command, Japan, Germany, Hawaii, South Korea, Bulgaria, Philippines, Poland, Kosovo, European Command, Italy, and others to be determined, or both. The option period is incrementally funded with the following: fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2026 procurement; and fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance (when it becomes available). The Defense Health Agency, Defense Healthcare Management Systems Contracting Division, Rosslyn, Virginia, is the contracting activity. (Awarded Sept. 28, 2026).

AIR FORCE

The Boeing Co., Tukwila, Washington, has been awarded a $10,889,535 fixed-price incentive (firm-target), firm-fixed-price modification (P00190) to a previously awarded contract (FA8625-16-C-65990) for VC-25B test maintenance. Work will be performed at San Antonio, Texas, and is expected to be completed prior to flight test. This modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $4,508,429,742 from $4,497,540,207. The modification is separate from the contract’s firm-fixed-price engineering and manufacturing development efforts. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test, and evaluation funds in the amount of $5,000,000 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity.

ARMY

Marlin Construction Services Inc.,* Jackson, New Jersey, was awarded a $9,805,040 firm-fixed-price contract for rehabilitation of the eastern jetty of Cheesequake Creek, New Jersey. Bids were solicited via the internet with 12 received. Work will be performed in Laurence Harbor, New Jersey, with an estimated completion date of April 25, 2028. Fiscal 2022 operations and maintenance, civil funds in the amount of $9,805,040 were obligated at the time of the award. U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New York, New York, is the contracting activity (W912DS-27-C-A001).

* Small Business
